items.headline: Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life
items.excerpt: OpenAI Academy is bringing free, hands-on ChatGPT workshops to caregivers in five U.S. cities, helping them build practical AI skills for everyday life.

items.headline: Closing the AI guidance gap in education
items.excerpt: New ThinkYoung research and lessons from OpenAI’s EMEA education partnerships on supporting teachers, AI literacy, and independent learning.

items.headline: Work at the Frontier: AI’s effect on freelance work
items.excerpt: New research from OpenAI and Upwork finds shifting demand for freelance work, new skill combinations, and larger budgets and more hours for AI-related projects.

items.headline: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
items.excerpt: ChatGPT Enterprise is now available through AWS Marketplace, helping organizations simplify procurement through existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships.

items.headline: Control Room: A central system to track and stop model workloads across our research infrastructure
items.excerpt: Learn how OpenAI’s Control Room tracks model workloads across our research infrastructure and can rapidly stop them when safety or security concerns arise.

items.headline: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
items.excerpt: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern and trust AI-generated code and Codex to ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team.

items.headline: Kuken Industries searches 70 years of drawings in minutes
items.excerpt: Kuken Industries uses the OpenAI API to search 70 years of cooling tower drawings. Engineers can find the drawing for a repair in 4.5 minutes, down from nearly an hour.

items.headline: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
items.excerpt: OpenAI is partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities, test connections with third-party services, and strengthen defenses with frontier AI.

items.headline: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
items.excerpt: OpenAI introduces BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark measuring how well AI agents interpret raw experimental data and handle everyday wet-lab science.

items.headline: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
items.excerpt: Australian universities are expanding access to ChatGPT and bringing AI into teaching and learning to prepare students for an AI-enabled workforce.

items.headline: Cult.fit builds operational muscle with Codex
items.excerpt: Cult.fit is using Codex to help teams across functions build tools, move faster, and change how work gets done.

items.headline: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
items.excerpt: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, OpenAI’s cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.

items.headline: Merge builds product and business tools with OpenAI technology
items.excerpt: Merge uses GPT-6 Astra, ChatGPT, and Codex to review product code and support marketing. Its teams also use AI to plan executive dinners and prepare sales updates.

items.headline: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
items.excerpt: OpenAI introduces its National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint to protect local resources, create jobs, and guide responsible AI infrastructure development.

items.headline: Flipsnack grows product signups with conversion optimization
items.excerpt: Flipsnack focused its ChatGPT Ads campaigns on getting people to try its product, growing registrations while lowering the cost per signup.

items.headline: Franklin Templeton uses OpenAI to support investment research
items.excerpt: Starting with equity research, Franklin Templeton is developing AI workflows to help portfolio managers compare research views and examine investment risks.

items.headline: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
items.excerpt: OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, expanding Codex’s tools for building, understanding, and reviewing code.

items.headline: Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
items.excerpt: Daybreak Red brings GPT-5.6 Cyber to approved customers in AWS GovCloud (US-East) through Amazon Bedrock for authorized cybersecurity work.

items.headline: A thousand fewer paths to root
items.excerpt: OpenAI built an autonomous pipeline that found, validated, and generated patches for 948 local privilege-escalation vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.

items.headline: Introducing Images 2.6
items.excerpt: Images 2.6 brings faster image generation, GIF creation, more precise editing, and new API controls across ChatGPT, Codex, and the API.

items.headline: DevRev delivers autonomous self-service with GPT-6.1 Sol
items.excerpt: DevRev uses GPT-6.1 Sol to power Computer and Operator, balancing reasoning, speed, and cost for enterprise service.
